reviews.text:

reviews.title: Services
reviews.text: Beware!!There are NOT enough available sitters to justify paying a premium fee monthly or annually.  I receive 1 respond to a request.  So why pay a premium fee before determining if it’s a good fit and/or the services provide more sitters for you to choose from.

reviews.title: Unreliable Reviews
reviews.text: Allowing a single customer to leave multiple reviews is highly misleading and undermines the credibility of the platform. Discovering that some caregiver reviews are inaccurate makes it difficult to trust the rating system altogether. If the reviews lack credibility, they lose their entire purpose.

reviews.title: Too much PI to view
reviews.text: Would have liked to see if this service would fit my needs but the amount of personal information required to even view the app is absurd. And since my states doesn’t afford personal privacy rights to avoid companies from using/selling my info, this is a hard pass.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. I can’t cancel an appointment and therefore I can’t book a time to have my pet taken care of.

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: This is probably the worst app on my phone. You can’t find any of the options for sitters. It’s so convoluted.

reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: My pet is literally suffering given changes in schedule, lack of walk confirmation, don’t make you dogs suffer don’t work with this app.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Just downloaded and I’m already suspended for no reason and the app is asking me to pay $299

reviews.title: Only one chance for first impression
reviews.text: We booked a sitting service for a single day, 8 am to 8 pm. Had a good interaction with the caregiver via chat, but received a cancellation from her at 7:30 the morning of. We ended up cancelling our plans and Wag! has charged us 31.50 for the cancellation, even though the cancellation request was marked as sitter cancelled. I’ll not use them again and would not recommend them.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service, continued to be charged
reviews.text: For months I have tried to cancel my membership. The chat shuts you down when you ask to speak to cancel or speak to a person. Requires you to fill out a form to cancel and then doesn’t cancel until they review and you have to confirm by email but it’s unclear when that happens. It’s not a lot of money but it’s clear they do not care about their clients if they make it this difficult. Do not use this service

reviews.title: Does not give walkers any part of cancellation fees
reviews.text: Wag charges customers a $5 fee for cancellation a walk and uses this as part of the reason for the fee (per their Aug 2026 policy):  “Remember, Wag! is a live environment and by submitting a service request you are asking local Caregivers to set aside their time to perform your pet care request. This policy ensures that the Pet Caregivers using the Wag! Platform to manage their pet care business are compensated…” Yet Wag does NOT compensate the walkers for cancelled walks, even though they bulk to customer for $5 every time a walk is cancelled (even three days in advance).  This is deceptive business, and I would encourage Wag customers and walkers to report this to their BBB or state Attorney General’s office for each occurrence so that class action can be considered.

reviews.title: Options? What Options
reviews.text: I put a request in yesterday and got one overpriced response from a caregiver. This morning, I got a text telling me I had options but the only response in my queue was the one from yesterday. Total POS.

reviews.title: Cancellations are a mess
reviews.text:
If the sitter cancels on you at the last second, the Wag app doesn’t do anything to notify you. We were out all day and I went to open the app about an hour after our booking was supposed to happen, and that was when I learned that we had been cancelled on and our dog was never visited.

Wag really needs to have an automated way of notifying the dog’s owner when this happens.

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever. If I could rate a negative amount I would. Pet families BEWARE.
reviews.text:
I booked a week long stay with Wag! and have regretted it since before the end of day 2. 

I met my sitter in person once 2 days prior to our scheduled sitting and she let me know she was homeless and using this app to get paid and have a place to live. I’m a fairly understanding person and my only other option was to cancel the first vacation I’ve been on in nearly a decade that was nonrefundable. 

Day one went fairly well, minus for the fact my security cameras stopped working.) On day 2 my sitter stopped responding. Day 3 she said her phone broke. Everything seemed to be decent enough minus for my sitter ignoring basic requests such as feeding instructions, placing the cone on the dog to avoid her chewing a tumor, etc.) 

I tell her I’m going to be coming home a few hours early with 24 hours advance notice. She panicked about this, but obviously had to choice in the matter. I told her we were in no rush to leave if she needed to finish laundry, shower, wanted to sleep in, etc. 

We get home and all her stuff is packed and ready to go, minus some drying laundry. No big deal. She gets ready to leave with all her belongings then frantically comes back to the door because she “lost her phone”. She keeps attempting to go back upstairs, but my fiancé and I both looked around the bedroom for her and there was no phone. She says she probably left it in her car then we hear her peeling out and driving like a bat out of hell. I get a text confirming she found the phone. 

10 minute

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: The person who was supposed to watch my dog wouldn't respond and completely ghosted me 2 hours before my flight was supposed to take off. And then charged me an 100 dollar fee for cancellation when the lady didn't want to do something I had already paid her for this is completely ridiculous I'm just now getting a refund three months later.

reviews.title: Wag doesn’t look out for their caregivers
reviews.text: I have been on Wag for 3 years now and in the past few weeks I have accepted several walks from pet owners and they have all cancelled at the last minute due to poor planning on their part. Wag lets them cancel at the last minute and does not compensate the caregiver. I have reached out several times and the only help I get is an AI generated support that just spits out their policies. I keep asking that they please reconsider their policies so it is more fair and I don’t get any response in return. I am highly rated on this app, responsible and reliable. I understand things happen but I had the same pet owner cancel on me two nights in a row on a holiday weekend and Wag did not  care. I had another owner tell me they had to cancel after I already showed up because they didn’t have a key ready for me to get in.  I am very frustrated with Wag!  If you download this app, proceed with caution!

reviews.title: Never got a real request
reviews.text: This app sucks, they made me paid for the subscription to have access to pet caregiver, and it’s been almost 6 months, and I haven’t received anything!

reviews.title: Twice no show & no notice
reviews.text: This is the second time this service has canceled my reservation without notice and without contacting me. I’m horrified and feel stupid for giving them another chance.

reviews.title: Price GOUGING PET PARENTS
reviews.text:
Wag! SHOULD BE ASHAMED OF THEMSELVES FOR HOW MUCH THEY PRICE GOUGE PET PARENTS. 

It cost over $900 for me to get my dog watch meanwhile the sitter only makes $500. THIS APP IS LUCKY I CANNOT POST THE RECEIPTS HERE.

SHAME ON YOU. There will be an article written about this!!!

reviews.title: $99 for a meet and greet
reviews.text: In order to do a meet and greet you need to “book” a service. After our meet and greet we did not want to proceed with the service, and therefore had to “cancel”. We were charged $99, only a fraction of which went to the boarder we did the meet and greet with.

reviews.title: Poorly made app
reviews.text: Many screens have no back buttons, poorly tracks user state which often requires force closing the app to recover. God forbid you tap a notification, it’ll clear from Notification Center but the app will never tell you what the notification was for. As for the service itself, the walkers are great but the booking system is insane and overly optimistic about arrival times.

reviews.title: The app is struggled to book walks - it’s whole point in existing
reviews.text: I used wag for 40plus walks without much isssues. Something changed where it had trouble processing payment or connecting to walkers. Did everything I could think of on my end and contacted there customer service and was blown off. Sent an email letting them know my experience and I’d was moving on to another service then they wanted to help so I wouldn’t leave.

reviews.title: Terrible user-inner face
reviews.text: Just a terrible user-inner face as someone who uses it to make money

reviews.title: Dog walkers be warned..
reviews.text: Dog walkers: just so you know, this company will not pay you if you get bit and can’t finish the job as a result of an incident. You will not get paid for your time and gas getting to a job and as such, they encourage you to not report the incident.

reviews.title: Test walk in different state
reviews.text: I just got my profile and see a test walk in Alaska when I live in Washington State. I messaged with the help chat and it gave me a bunch of suggestions that did help the issue at all and wouldn’t listen when we responded with feedback after its suggestions.

reviews.title: Wag stole $80 from me, denied it then deactivated my account! AVOID THIS APP ⚠️
reviews.text: I have the bank records to prove it.

reviews.title: Rip Off
reviews.text: I was robbed for a request

reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text: Horrible app, constantly trying to upgrade you to pay extra literally every thing you click on. Also won’t let you cancel mistakes even if you hit cancel 20 seconds later

reviews.title: No customer support
reviews.text: Wag cancelled my dog sitting booking even though my sitter and I were messaging. This caused my dogs to not have care& no notification was given stating why or who cancelled. My messages with the sitter were deleted as they were connected to the sitting. I have reached out to the “email” as that’s the only option. No one will call me to discuss this huge mistake on their end & im completely dissatisfied with the response time. No accountability on their end. Mind you they canceled at 9 pm and I had to find other care.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.text:
I’ve used Wag multiple times with good experiences, but my recent pet sitting experience was extremely disappointing. The caregiver provided very little communication, did not follow important care instructions, and I had serious concerns about whether my dog was receiving adequate care while I was away.

What has been even more frustrating is Wag’s customer support. I reported the issue, was contacted to schedule a follow-up call, provided my availability, and then received no response despite multiple follow-ups and their stated response timeframe.

When you trust a company with your pet, you need confidence that both the caregivers and the support team will be there when something goes wrong. Unfortunately, this experience has seriously impacted my trust in Wag.

reviews.title: Wag Nightmare
reviews.text: Used the Wag app, first girl canceled on me 15mins before she was supposed to show up. Then, I hired another girl. The app kicked her off and me off where we couldn’t contact each other, so i freaked out. She had my house key and my animals wouldn’t have been taken care of for 3 days. I deleted the app. Very scary and do not recommend, do not think it’s safe.

reviews.title: No real time updates
reviews.text:
I left two dogs with nice sitter for the whole day, but I never received any messages or updates all day. I was worried since it was my first time using your service. 
I’m accustomed to getting text message or a quick photo on my phone to reassure me things are okay.

reviews.title: App
reviews.text: App not user friendly.

reviews.title: Terrible system just use rover
reviews.text: You can’t message or view possible dog walkers without paying. They make you submit one specific time, even if you are flexible on time, and then send that request out to everyone on wag. It’s then up to the walkers if they are able to accommodate that one time and reach out to you. Rover at least lets you view 100+ potential dog walkers in your area, then you can message and have a conversation with them to figure out a good schedule. This system makes no sense.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: There is no way to get a hold of a customer service representative by phone. Literally 0. This means that if there is an emergency with your pet, you have to email them, and someone will call you back when the email has been received if the email is even being reviewed by an actual human. There’s no timeline for that, either. The account login is antiquated. The company takes a huge percentage from the walkers including from their tips. Do yourself a favor and use another method of finding pet care.

reviews.title: No customer support
reviews.text: Late caregivers :(

reviews.title: Impossible to cancel
reviews.text: Sadly, this is yet another 2000’s era gym where it is impossible to cancel membership. Just join for the time you need

reviews.title: App functionality is abysmal
reviews.text: I created an account, added my request on the website and received a text message that I needed to download the app to see who responded. I downloaded it, but it literally did not work properly. The authentication was via a code sent to my email which I input, but there was nowhere to hit enter and it did not automatically go to the next page. Terrible app.

reviews.title: User Beware!
reviews.text:
This app will put strangers in your home and delete any communications you had that you were planning to come take care of your pet. 

A real bait and switch.

reviews.title: Disappointed and Frustrated
reviews.text:
I had scheduled a 13-day boarding stay and arrived within the agreed-upon drop-off window that we had texted about previously with a caregiver in Ohio named Calia R. After arriving, I knocked multiple times, called, and sent messages but received no response. I waited, left briefly, returned, and still was unable to make contact. A neighbor confirmed I was at the correct address and that the sitter’s vehicle was present.

The lack of communication created a very stressful situation, as I had a flight departing later that day and was forced to scramble to find emergency boarding arrangements for my dog on short notice.

I understand that emergencies and unexpected situations can happen, but timely communication is essential when caring for someone’s pet, especially for a long-term booking. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend this sitter or the app due to getting no help with a reboarding procedure, and since I could not get ahold of anyone in the app even though I went through the support progress I received no response.

reviews.title: Last minute cancellations
reviews.text: Caregivers are allowed to cancel on services as the last minute, leaving pet owners in a panic as they are leaving for travel.

reviews.title: Worst customer support ever
reviews.text: The only good thing I can say is that I found wonderful care givers. As for the app and customer service, it’s an unmitigated nightmare. You can’t talk to anybody other than AI, which goes around in circles. I was charged almost $400 of bogus charges, beside the $226 for the care giver, and so far I’ve had no recourse. None of my communication with emails and chats and their “tickets” have gotten zero response. I wasted hours on the phone typing, got hung up on 4 times, total nightmare. Absolute worst customer service bar none. Good luck if you have a problem.

reviews.title: Be careful of the auto-book setting!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and sent out an inquiry and then realized that this app requires all dogs to be vaccinated. I never booked anything and I never did any meet & greets with sitters, but the app auto booked a the best match for my inquiry. A sitter showed up, and I wasn’t even in the same city! I never got any confirmation emails. But now I have a balance due!

reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text: Idk if it’s just my area but it takes a while for the walkers to confirm and the walks can be so expensive even when signing up with the monthly subscription that’s suppose to give you a “discount” .. I literally pay the same price including the monthly subscription so there’s literally no point. It can be useful when you can actually get someone to confirm. Again, it could just be my area.

reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text: Booked a service. Had them meet my dog. Then cancelled and ghosted. App was no help

My dogs used to love Wag, and customer service worked with me on refunds when my chihuahua would refuse to go. Then a walker lost my house key, and Wag couldn’t have cared less. No offer to replace the key or locks or anything. That was 8 yrs ago, and I haven’t used them since. Today one of my friends sent me a link to endorse her to be a walker, and it forced me to download the app again and log on. All of that just so the stupid app wouldn’t work.

reviews.title: Manipulative Notification Settings
reviews.text: This app won’t allow you to receive important notifications about pet sitter visits or walks without also getting a barrage of marketing notifications and promotions. This is intentional on their end.
